name: tests-50pct-yunikorn-core-isolated-metrics-domains-for-9922
instr:
YuniKorn cannot run concurrent service contexts with independently gathered Prometheus metrics without registration conflicts or cross-context observations. Give each context one stable metrics-domain identity shared by its scheduler, history, runtime refresh, queue lifecycle, web exposition, and shutdown. Preserve process-default behavior when isolation is not requested.

Every `MetricsDomain` created by `NewMetricsDomain` owns its collector registrations, values, dynamic resource labels, and queue retirement semantics during concurrent refresh and gathering. Record every scheduler observation only in its retained domain, including cycles, node changes, applications, allocations, releases, resource updates, and errors. Internal history and HTTP exposition must read, refresh, and gather that same domain. Stopping or recreating one context must not affect another live context's samples, history progress, or endpoint availability.

Keep existing startup functions, package-level metrics accessors, `NewInternalMetricsCollector`, `NewScheduler`, and `NewWebApp` on the process-default domain. Preserve queue recreation, manual-service shutdown, metrics route, and response behavior. The metrics package at `github.com/apache/yunikorn-core/pkg/metrics` must expose `MetricsDomain`, `NewMetricsDomain`, `Gather`, `SchedulerMetrics`, `QueueMetrics`, `RemoveQueueMetrics`, `RuntimeMetrics`, and `NewInternalMetricsCollectorWithDomain`.
